info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Card Terminal Operation Operational Action-spec
info.description: The Card Terminal Operational Actions API allows businesses to initiate and manage operational actions related to card terminals within their banking infrastructure. This endpoint performs actions necessary for the proper functioning and maintenance of card terminal systems. Typically utilized by banking institutions and payment processors, it enables users to streamline terminal operations and enhance service delivery. Leveraging this API, developers can automate processes, ensuring efficiency in operational workflows and improving customer experiences.

post.summary: Initiates operational actions for card terminals.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to initiate various operational actions for card terminals associated with a specific channel. It is essential for managing terminal states and ensuring smooth operations.
